# Road Runner Sports

> > Road Runner Sports is a premium running retailer offering curated running shoes, gear, and exclusive VIP loyalty programs with expert fit technology.

Road Runner Sports specializes in running footwear and athletic gear from top brands including Nike, HOKA, Brooks, ASICS, Adidas, New Balance, Saucony, On, Altra, and Mizuno. The company operates both online and physical retail locations with a Fit Finder technology and offers multiple VIP membership tiers featuring rewards cash, free shipping, and a Perfect Fit Guarantee.

## Running Shoe Brands

- [Nike Running Shoes & Apparel](https://www.roadrunnersports.com/brands/nike): Nike running shoes and apparel featuring Pegasus 41 and Vomero 18
- [HOKA Running Shoes](https://www.roadrunnersports.com/brands/hoka): HOKA brand running shoes including Clifton 10, Bondi 9, and Mach 7
- [Brooks Running Shoes](https://www.roadrunnersports.com/brands/brooks): Brooks running shoes collection including Glycerin 23 and Adrenaline GTS
- [ASICS Running Shoes](https://www.roadrunnersports.com/brands/asics): ASICS running shoes collection with GEL-Nimbus and GEL-Kayano models
- [Adidas Running Shoes & Apparel](https://www.roadrunnersports.com/brands/adidas): Adidas running shoes and apparel including Ultra Boost and Solar Glide
- [New Balance Running Shoes](https://www.roadrunnersports.com/brands/new-balance): New Balance running shoes with FuelCell and Fresh Foam technology
- [On Running Shoes](https://www.roadrunnersports.com/brands/on): On running shoes collection featuring Cloudrunner 3 and Cloudmonster 3
- [Saucony Running Shoes](https://www.roadrunnersports.com/brands/saucony): Saucony running shoes including Ride 19 and Triumph 23 models
- [Altra Running Shoes](https://www.roadrunnersports.com/brands/altra): Altra running shoes featuring Torin 8 and EGO MAX cushioning technology
- [Mizuno Running Shoes](https://www.roadrunnersports.com/brands/mizuno): Mizuno running shoes including Wave Rider and Wave Inspire models
